name: measure before release — placeholder budget; 97.96 kB brotli on Linux at main 011e2237b (W10), then 100.04 kB with W4's viewer-first open (D9 pending entries read through the authority under a no-progress stall, `pendingPaths` and pending rows in the index snapshot, and a tree write's expected entries known to the index before they land), about 2.1 kB (brotli on Linux, 2026-11-06; limit raised from 100 kB to 100.3 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7), then 100.49 kB with W3.2's warm open (FileSystemAccessProvider keeps a bounded file-handle cache, so a warm stat is one getFile()), about 0.2 kB (brotli on Linux, 2026-11-07; limit raised from 100.3 kB to 100.5 kB, within the agent band of npm-policy § 7)
